title: Allies of Allah and Those Who Mock

paragraphs.text: Who judges better than Allah? Do not take the Jews and the Christians as allies. Some with sick hearts rush to them. Later they will be sorry. Their deeds become worthless.

If some leave their religion, Allah will bring others. He loves them, and they love Him. They strive for Allah and do not fear blame. Your ally is Allah, His Messenger and the believers. The party of Allah will win. Do not befriend those who mock your religion.
Some say they believe, but disbelief stays in their hearts. Many rush into sin and eat what is unlawful. Why do their scholars not stop them?
Some said that Allah's hand is chained. No, both His hands are open wide. He gives as He wills. If they had believed, they would enter Gardens of Pleasure. Some are fair, but many do evil.

hardWords.m: friends who help and support each other
